# Columns: ID | Fiber | Polymer system | E1 | E2 | G12 | nu12 | nu23 | G23 | Xc | Xt | Yc | Yt | S12 | t_ply | Source
#   Xc/Xt = longitudinal compressive/tensile strength, Yc/Yt = transverse compressive/tensile strength,
#   S12 = in-plane shear strength. Strengths are positive magnitudes.
#   NA = not reported by the source.  * = estimate, not measured:
#     nu23* : matrix-dominated default (0.45 carbon/epoxy, 0.40 glass & basalt/epoxy, 0.45 flax)
#             or taken from the AS4/PEEK set L026 (0.49) for PEEK/PAEK rows.
#     G23*  : G23 = E2 / (2 (1 + nu23))  (transverse isotropy, same relation as PlyPropertyGenerator).
#     t*    : see per-ID note.
#   Conditions are room temperature dry/ambient, mean (not B-basis) values unless noted.
#   Unit conversions from US units: 1 ksi = 6.894757 MPa, 1 Msi = 6.894757 GPa, 1 in = 25.4 mm.
#

#  L009 FAA DOT/FAA/TC-19/50 Pt 2 (ASU, MAT213), 3-5 specimen averages. nu23 (=nu32, single specimen) and G23 measured; they do not satisfy G23 = E2/(2(1+nu23)) (would give 2.55). Xc (ASTM D3410) is suspiciously low. S12 = peak at ~13% strain. t* = 3.1 mm / 16 plies.
